subject.title: fix(gateway): deliver OAuth authorization URLs to non-terminal clients

question: Should OpenClaw accept `WizardPrompter.presentsAuthChallenge` as the plugin-facing contract for auth-presenting RPC clients and treat those clients as manual/remote OAuth clients for provider auth routing?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible, but it changes a public prompter capability and provider auth routing semantics that green tests do not settle as a product/API compatibility choice.

options.title: Accept After Proof And Rebase
options.body: Require inspectable companion proof and a clean merge state, then accept the additive auth-presenting prompter contract for this OAuth bug fix.

options.title: Narrow The Contract First
options.body: Ask for a smaller or differently named internal seam if maintainers do not want this capability exposed through the plugin-facing WizardPrompter type yet.

options.title: Pause Behind The Umbrella
options.body: Keep this PR paused while the broader wizard RPC parity issue settles one combined protocol direction for auth challenges, progress, and pairing artifacts.

recommendation.title: Accept After Proof And Rebase
recommendation.body: Require inspectable companion proof and a clean merge state, then accept the additive auth-presenting prompter contract for this OAuth bug fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is prior provider auth and OAuth prompt ownership in the shared surfaces that define this contract.
